wanting to do sth or wanting sth to happen very much

ex.en: John was very keen to help.
ex.cn: 约翰很热心，愿意帮忙。

senses.def: enthusiastic about an activity or idea, etc.

ex.cn: 热心运动的人

ex.cn: 这个队最热情的支持者之一

senses.def: liking sb/sth very much; very interested in sb/sth

ex.en: Tom's very keen on Anna.
ex.cn: 汤姆迷上了安娜。

ex.en: She's not keen on being told what to do.
ex.cn: 她不喜欢别人向她发号施令。

ex.cn: 你喜欢他们的新房子吗？

ex.en: I like to see them enjoying themselves.
ex.cn: 我就愿意看着他们玩得高兴。

ex.en: He loved the way she smiled.
ex.cn: 他喜欢她微笑的样子。

ex.en: We were fond of the house and didn't want to leave.
ex.cn: 我们喜欢上了这座房子，不想搬家。

senses.def: quick to understand

ex.cn: 我们挤在一起来保暖。

ex.en: The notice said 'Keep off (= Do not walk on) the grass'.
ex.cn: 牌子上写着 “勿践踏草地”。

ex.en: Keep left along the wall.
ex.cn: 沿着墙靠左边走。

ex.en: She kept the children amused for hours.
ex.cn: 她陪孩子们玩了好几个小时。

ex.en: He kept his coat on.
ex.cn: 他一直穿着大衣。

ex.en: Don't keep us in suspense —what happened next?
ex.cn: 别跟我们卖关子了，接下来发生了什么事？

senses.def: to continue doing sth; to do sth repeatedly

ex.en: Keep smiling!
ex.cn: 要保持笑容！

ex.en: Don't keep on interrupting me!
ex.cn: 别老是跟我打岔！

ex.en: You're an hour late—what kept you?
ex.cn: 你晚了一小时，什么事把你给耽误了？

senses.def: to continue to have sth and not give it back or throw it away

ex.en: Here's a five dollar bill—please keep the change.
ex.cn: 给你一张五美元的钞票，零钱就不用找了。

ex.en: I keep all her letters.
ex.cn: 我把她所有的信都保留着。

senses.def: to save sth for sb

ex.en: Please keep a seat for me.
ex.cn: 请给我留个座位。

ex.en: Please keep me a seat.
ex.cn: 请给我留个座位。

senses.def: to put or store sth in a particular place

ex.en: Keep your passport in a safe place.
ex.cn: 把你的护照放在安全的地方。

senses.def: to own and manage a shop/store or restaurant
senses.chn: 开设，经营，管理（商店或餐馆）

ex.en: Her father kept a grocer's shop.
ex.cn: 她父亲开了个杂货店。

senses.def: to own and care for animals

ex.en: to keep bees/goats/hens
ex.cn: 养蜜蜂／山羊／母鸡

senses.def: used to ask or talk about sb's health

ex.en: How is your mother keeping?
ex.cn: 你母亲身体好吗？

ex.en: We're all keeping well.
ex.cn: 我们都很健康。

ex.en: Finish off the pie—it won't keep.
ex.cn: 把馅饼都吃了吧，这东西不耐放。

ex.en: 'I'd love to hear about it, but I'm late already.' 'That's OK— it'll keep (= I can tell you about it later).'
ex.cn: “我很想听听，不过我已经迟到了。” “好吧，我以后再告诉你。”

senses.def: to know sth and not tell it to anyone

ex.en: Can you keep a secret?
ex.cn: 你能保守秘密吗？

ex.en: She kept her past secret from us all.
ex.cn: 她对我们所有人都避而不谈她的过去。

senses.def: to do what you have promised to do; to go where you have agreed to go

ex.en: She kept her promise to visit them.
ex.cn: 她遵守诺言去看望了他们。

ex.en: He failed to keep his appointment at the clinic.
ex.cn: 他未能按预约的时间去诊所。

senses.def: to write down sth as a record
senses.chn: 记下，记录，记载（日记、账目、记录等）

ex.en: She kept a diary for over twenty years.
ex.cn: 她记了二十多年的日记。

ex.en: Keep a note of where each item can be found.
ex.cn: 把每样物品的位置记录下来。

senses.def: to provide what is necessary for sb to live; to support sb by paying for food, etc.

ex.en: He scarcely earns enough to keep himself and his family.
ex.cn: 他挣的钱几乎不够养活他自己和家人。

senses.def: to protect sb from sth

ex.en: May the Lord bless you and keep you (= used in prayers in the Christian Church).
ex.cn: 愿上帝祝福你、保佑你（用于基督教的祈祷）。

ex.en: His only thought was to keep the boy from harm.
ex.cn: 他一心想的就是不要让这男孩受到伤害。

senses.def: to guard or protect the goal or wicket
to make an effort to live normally when you are in a difficult situation or when you have experienced great suffering
senses.chn: （在身处困境或遭难时）尽力维持下去，坚持活下去

ex.en: You just have to keep yourself busy and keep going.
ex.cn: 你必须让自己忙起来并坚持下去。

senses.def: used to encourage sb to continue doing sth
senses.chn: （用于鼓励）继续下去，坚持下去

ex.en: Keep going, Sarah, you're nearly there.
ex.cn: 坚持下去，萨拉，你已经快到了。

senses.def: to be enough for sb until they get what they are waiting for
senses.chn: 足以使某人维持（或支撑）

ex.en: Have an apple to keep you going till dinner time.
ex.cn: 吃个苹果就能挨到吃晚饭了。

senses.def: to make a student stay at school after normal hours as a punishment
to continue working at sth

ex.en: Come on, keep at it, you've nearly finished!
ex.cn: 快，要坚持，你马上就要完成了！

senses.def: to make sb continue working at sth
senses.chn: 使某人继续做（或坚持干）某事

ex.en: He kept us at it all day.
ex.cn: 他让我们不停地干了一天。

senses.def: to avoid going near sb/sth

ex.en: Keep away from the edge of the cliff.
ex.cn: 切莫靠近悬崖边。

senses.def: to prevent sb/sth from going somewhere
senses.chn: 不让接近某人（或某事物）；使离开

ex.en: Her illness kept her away from work for several weeks.
ex.cn: 她病得好几周都上不了班。

senses.def: to stay at a distance from sb/sth

ex.en: Keep well back from the road.
ex.cn: 离公路远些。

senses.def: to make a student stay at school after normal hours as a punishment
to make a student repeat a year at school because of poor marks/grades
to make sb stay at a distance from sb/sth

ex.en: Barricades were erected to keep back the crowds.
ex.cn: 设置了障碍，使人群无法靠近。

senses.def: to prevent a feeling, etc. from being expressed
senses.chn: 抑制（或阻止）感情等的流露

ex.en: She was unable to keep back her tears.
ex.cn: 她无法忍住泪水。

senses.def: to continue to have a part of sth
senses.chn: 保留（或扣留）某物的一部分

ex.en: He kept back half the money for himself.
ex.cn: 他把那笔钱留了一半给自己。

senses.def: to refuse to tell sb sth

ex.en: I'm sure she's keeping something back from us.
ex.cn: 我肯定她有什么事瞒着我们。

senses.def: to hide yourself by not standing up straight

ex.en: Keep down! You mustn't let anyone see you.
ex.cn: 蹲下！千万不要让人看见你。

senses.def: to prevent a person, group, etc. from expressing themselves freely

ex.en: The people have been kept down for years by a brutal regime.
ex.cn: 多年来人们一直受到残暴统治的压制。

senses.def: to make sth stay at a low level; to avoid increasing sth
senses.chn: 使保持在低水平；抑制某事物的增长

ex.en: to keep down wages/prices/the cost of living
ex.cn: 保持低工资／物价／生活费用

ex.en: Keep your voice down—I don't want anyone else to hear.
ex.cn: 小声点儿，别让人听见。

ex.en: Keep the noise down (= be quiet).
ex.cn: 小声点儿。

senses.def: to not bring sth back through the mouth from the stomach; to not vomit
senses.chn: 不使（胃中食物）吐出；不呕吐

ex.en: She's had some water but she can't keep any food down.
ex.cn: 她喝了点儿水，但一吃东西就吐。

senses.def: to prevent yourself from doing sth
senses.chn: 忍住（或克制自己）不做某事

ex.en: She could hardly keep from laughing.
ex.cn: 她差一点儿笑了出来。

ex.en: I just managed to keep myself from falling.
ex.cn: 我差一点儿没摔倒。

senses.def: to prevent sb from doing sth
senses.chn: 阻止（或防止、阻碍）某人做某事

ex.en: I hope I'm not keeping you from your work.
ex.cn: 希望我没有妨碍你工作。

ex.en: The church bells keep me from sleeping.
ex.cn: 教堂的钟声使我不能入睡。

senses.def: to avoid telling sb sth
senses.chn: 不将某事告诉某人；瞒着某人

ex.en: I think we ought to keep the truth from him until he's better.
ex.cn: 我想我们应该等他身体好些再告诉他实情。

senses.def: to make sth stay out of sth
senses.chn: 使置于某物之外；使与某物分开

ex.cn: 她无法使自己沉重的心情不流露在话音之中。

senses.def: to make sure that you stay friendly with sb, because you will get an advantage from doing so
senses.chn: （为得到好处而）与某人友好相处，不得罪某人

senses.def: to avoid expressing an emotion

ex.en: He could scarcely keep in his indignation.
ex.cn: 他几乎控制不住自己的愤怒。

senses.def: to make sb stay indoors or in a particular place
senses.chn: 使某人留在室内（或某地）；使不外出

senses.def: to provide sb/yourself with a regular supply of sth
if rain, snow, etc. keeps off, it does not fall
to avoid eating, drinking or smoking sth

ex.en: I'm trying to keep off fatty foods.
ex.cn: 我尽量不吃高脂肪食物。

senses.def: to avoid mentioning a particular subject

ex.en: It's best to keep off politics when my father's around.
ex.cn: 我父亲在场时最好不要谈论政治。

senses.def: to prevent sb/sth from coming near, touching, etc. sb/sth
senses.chn: 使…不接近（或不接触、远离）某人／事物
